hospital.name: Healthcare Hospital & Clinic
hospital.description: Healthcare facility requiring sterile zones, emergency access, triage, ICU wards, and clear circulation corridors.
passive_climate_strategies: North-oriented patient wards for uniform glare-free day-lighting.
Negative pressure airflow systems in isolation rooms.
High air-change rates (minimum 12 ACH) via mechanical HVAC integration.

hotel.name: Hospitality Hotel & Resort
hotel.description: Multi-occupancy hospitality building featuring a grand lobby, guest suites, dining facilities, and service cores.
passive_climate_strategies: Shaded balconies on East/West facades to mitigate direct solar radiation.
Central atrium lightwell for natural illumination of internal guest corridors.
Acoustically isolated service risers and elevator cores.

restaurant.name: Commercial Dining Restaurant
restaurant.description: Food & beverage space designed for efficient customer flow, dining comfort, commercial kitchen workflow, and hygiene.
passive_climate_strategies: Dedicated kitchen exhaust heat recovery units.
Deep overhangs shading exterior dining verandas.
Operable facade louvers for cross-ventilation in temperate seasons.

police_station.name: Public Safety Police Station
police_station.description: Civic law enforcement building with secured perimeter zoning, holding cells, interrogation rooms, and administrative suites.
passive_climate_strategies: High thermal mass reinforced concrete exterior envelope.
Secured courtyard for tactical vehicle access and ventilation.
Zoned access control separating public lobby from detention wings.

library.name: Educational College Library
library.description: Academic knowledge facility with quiet study zones, digital research labs, discussion suites, and book archives.
passive_climate_strategies: North-facing high-light glazing for uniform glare-free reading illumination.
East-West service buffer alignment (toilets/storage) acting as thermal shields.
Automated roof louvers for stack-effect thermal buoyancy ventilation.

house.name: Residential House & Villa
house.description: Private residential home featuring family living spaces, private bedrooms, kitchen, and sanitary facilities.
passive_climate_strategies: South-facing living rooms for passive winter solar gain.
Cross-ventilation pathways connecting living and dining areas.
Deep verandah overhangs on West elevation.
